links.outcome: Accuracy of LLMs on cardiothoracic anesthesia board-style clinical knowledge questions
links.effect: Claude achieved 32% accuracy (32/100) and ChatGPT-4 23% (23/100), both below the 80% threshold considered acceptable for clinical decision-making.
links.quote: Claude achieved 32% accuracy (32/100 questions), while ChatGPT-4 achieved 23% accuracy (23/100 questions), representing a 9% point difference (p < 0.05).

links.outcome: Subspecialty benchmark accuracy of general LLMs versus their strong performance on general medical exams
links.effect: Both models scored well below the 80% clinical threshold on subspecialty questions (Claude 32%, ChatGPT-4 23%), despite prior proficiency on general medical licensing examinations.
links.quote: Both models performed below the threshold typically considered acceptable for clinical decision-making (≥80%).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (Claude and ChatGPT-4) on a benchmark of 100 cardiothoracic anesthesia board-style questions without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
